Version 1.4.0 — Major Update

- Improved research workflow: instructions now specify three distinct analytical sub-agents (breadth, critique, evidence), whose outputs are synthesized into one review report with unified bibliography.
- Added support for iterative research: outputs from previous runs can be reused as starting sources in future reports.
- Enhanced user interaction: requires explicit confirmation of topic, angle, output length, workspace, source handling, and model assignment before agent spawning.
- New file handling: clear procedures for collecting, documenting, and using user-provided sources; generates dedicated source and bibliography records.
- Stronger agent compatibility: details technical/workspace requirements, tool recommendations, and configuration steps for reproducibility and reliability.
